methodology: Conducted a targeted search on October 17, 2026, focusing on public posts from Atomos Technologies and mentions of Atomos products in the context of professional video production hardware. Excluded unrelated topics such as Final Fantasy XIV Atomos server, DJ Atomos, rap music, and ancient Greek atomism. Prioritized original posts and comments with explicit references to Atomos products and camera/recording contexts.
